preconditions: Confirm the target schema has applied migration 038 and prior migrations in numeric order.
Pause and drain Review Booster intake and delivery jobs before applying 040–041.
Apply each migration once, in numeric order, before deploying matching application consumers.

rollback.strategy: Forward-fix preferred; do not automatically reverse schema after application code starts using it.
rollback.dataLoss: Migration 040 preserves legacy rows as permission-incomplete; migration 041 backfills terminal timestamps only from recorded outcome timestamps and adds retention hold and provider-correlation evidence. Cleanup runbooks can irreversibly erase recipient payloads and delivery evidence; no cleanup is performed by these migrations.
rollback.recovery: If application deployment fails after schema application, roll back the application only to a version compatible with the new schema, keep Booster jobs paused, preserve schema and evidence, then forward-fix. For a migration failure, stop at the failed migration and restore from a verified pre-release backup or repair forward; do not run later migrations.
